one_line: 克利夫兰美术馆藏画作，馆方断代作「1755」。**本条为著录级**：照录馆方记录，未作阐释。

Andrew R. and Martha Holden Jennings Fund

basics.text: **本条为著录级条目。**以上各项照录克利夫兰美术馆的藏品记录，字段名标明「馆方」者即其原文。本库尚未对其作独立核校，亦未就断代、归属、风格作任何判断——分期归入依据仅为：朝代名 → qing；器类归入依据仅为：type=Painting。

items: Jiao yu bu di er ci quan guo mei shu zhan lan hui zhuan ji [敎育部第二次全國美術展覽會專集= A special collection of the second National Exhibition of Chinese Art under the auspices of the Ministry of Education]. Nanjing: Shang wu yin shu guan, 1937.（cat. no. 332）
Sirén, Osvald. Chinese Painting: Leading Masters and Principles. New York: Ronald Press, 1956.（Mentioned: VII, Lists, 348）
Fukunaga, Takehiko 福永武彥, and Howard L. Rogers. Kinnō, Bunjinga suihen. chiyūgo (9) 金農, 文人画粋編. 中国篇 9. Tōkyō: Chūōkoronsha, 1976.（Mentioned and Reproduced: p. 172, pl. 47）

Ho, Wai-kam, Sherman E. Lee, Laurence Sickman, and Marc F. Wilson. Eight Dynasties of Chinese Painting: The Collections of the Nelson Gallery-Atkins Museum, Kansas City, and the Cleveland Museum of Art. Cleveland, OH: Cleveland Museum of Art, in cooperation with Indiana University Press, 1980.（Referenced: cat. no. 269, pp. 367-368）

Chung, Anita. "Traditions and The Modernist Vision: Chinese Paintings of Chen Wen Hsi." In Convergences: Chen Wen Hsi centennial exhibition [汇流 : 陈文希百年诞辰纪念展 = Hui liu: Chen Wenxi bai nian dan chen ji nian zhan]. Singapore: Singapore Art Museum, 2006（Mentioned and Reproduced: p.192, fig. 1）

dating.text: 馆方著录中有含纪年的款识（见「题跋与鉴藏」一节），其年份与馆方断代一致，故断代依据可以填「款识」而不再是无从得知。**只给「较可靠」不给「确证」**：本库未核对原件，款识本身的真伪、是否后添均未独立判定。
款识原文未经本库目验；馆方亦未说明其对该款识真伪的判断。

colophons.text:
乾隆乙亥年燈節前二日癭瓢子慎写。 [印]黃慎; 恭壽。

馆方英译：Artist's inscription, signature, and 2 seals: 

Two days before the Lantern Festival in the yihai year of Qianlong [1755], drawn by Yingpiaozi, Shen. [seals] Huang Shen; Gongshou.
以上为克利夫兰美术馆藏品记录里的题跋与钤印著录，**本库未核对原件**；款印的真伪、题跋者身份与年代均未独立判定。
